roadmap.title: Early story: northern island
roadmap.description: Play the first story missions and activate radio towers as you find them. Pick up the glider jump, camera tagging and the hidden Hollywood star near the start.

roadmap.title: Story and side content
roadmap.description: Continue the story while liberating outposts, buying skills, crafting, hunting, poker and the optional quests. Buy the collectible maps once the towers are on.

roadmap.title: South island and cleanup
roadmap.description: Finish the story, then clear the remaining outposts, collectibles and skills in free roam.

achievements.description: Escape the pirates and survive in the wilderness.
achievements.summary: Finish the first story mission by escaping the pirates.

steps.text: Play the opening story mission through to the end.

achievements.description: Return to the doctor with the cave mushrooms.
achievements.summary: Bring the mushrooms from the cave back to the doctor in the story.

steps.text: Play the mushroom-cave story mission and return to the doctor.

achievements.summary: Rescue Liza from the burning hotel in the story.

steps.text: Play the hotel story mission until Liza is out of the burning building.

achievements.summary: Finish the Rakyat initiation in the story.

steps.text: Play the story through the Rakyat initiation mission.

achievements.description: Rescue your friend before he is sold as a slave.
achievements.summary: Rescue Oliver from the pirates in the story.

steps.text: Play the story mission where you rescue Oliver.

achievements.summary: Rescue Keith from Buck in the story.

steps.text: Play the story mission where you rescue Keith, including the one-on-one fight with @enemy{Buck}.

achievements.summary: Survive the story encounter with Vaas and escape.

steps.text: Play the story mission where @npc{Vaas} confronts you and escape alive.

achievements.description: Survive Vaas’s attack in the compound.
achievements.summary: Kill Vaas in the story.

steps.text: Play the story until the fight where you kill @npc{Vaas}.

achievements.summary: Reach the southern island with the wingsuit in the story.

steps.text: Play the story mission that has you fly the @item{wingsuit} to the southern island.

achievements.description: Don’t blow cover during the interrogation.
achievements.summary: Finish the story interrogation of Riley without blowing your cover.

steps.text: Play the interrogation mission with Riley and avoid blowing your cover.

achievements.summary: Kill Hoyt in the story.

steps.text: Play the story through the mission where you kill @npc{Hoyt}.

achievements.summary: Attend the final ceremony in the story.

steps.text: Play the story to the final ceremony.

achievements.description: Freefall more than 100m and live (Single Player only).
achievements.summary: Fall more than 100 m and survive in single player.

guide.context: If the glider does not appear, die a few times until it spawns.

steps.text: Go to X 442.4, Y 651.1 on the map and climb almost to the top of the mountain to the yellow @item{glider}.
Use the glider and keep it straight. Do not steer.
Once you are over the ocean, release the glider. Landing in the water unlocks the achievement.

achievements.summary: Earn 5 skill tattoos by buying 5 skills.

guide.context: A skill point comes each time the XP bar fills. Story missions, side quests, collectibles and kills all give XP.

steps.text: Open the pause menu and spend skill points on any 5 skills. Each skill gives a tattoo.

achievements.description: Earn every tattoo by learning all the skills.
achievements.summary: Earn every tattoo by learning every skill.

guide.context: Normal play gives enough XP. If the story is done, use Reset Outposts in the gameplay settings to redo outpost kills.

steps.text: There are 54 skills across three trees named @mechanic{Heron}, @mechanic{Shark} and @mechanic{Spider}. Buy every one.
Unlock the skills that need an action first: jump onto an enemy below you for a kill, kill an enemy above you on a climbable ledge, and liberate 2 outposts without being detected.
Finish 3 Supply Drop quests and 3 Wanted Dead quests. This opens the Adrenaline Surge and Dealmaker skills.
Meet any other locked skill's goal, such as 10 kills with mounted weapons, 5 relics, 5 grenade kills, 10 healing syringes crafted or $500 spent in shops.

achievements.summary: Spend $5000 at the shop.

guide.context: Buying all the collectible maps costs $4000 by itself.

steps.text: Spend money at any shop on ammo, weapons, attachments, paint jobs or maps. The total across visits counts.

achievements.description: Buy all attachments and paint jobs for one weapon.
achievements.summary: Buy every attachment and paint job for one weapon.

guide.context: The 1911 has no attachments, so it is the cheapest weapon to finish.

steps.text: Open a shop and choose to customize the 1911 pistol. Buy all 6 paint jobs at $200 each, $1200 in total.

achievements.summary: Liberate 3 outposts.

steps.text: Go to an outpost on the map and kill every guard. Do this at 3 outposts.

achievements.summary: Liberate all 34 outposts.

guide.context: Liberated outposts can be reset in the gameplay settings if you need more to farm.

steps.text: Liberate every outpost on both islands. The Handbook tab in the pause menu tracks progress.

achievements.description: Liberate an outpost without triggering an alarm.
achievements.summary: Liberate an outpost without any alarm being triggered.

guide.context: If an alarm rings, die and respawn near the outpost to try again, or reset outposts.

steps.text: Find the alarm panel in an outpost and hold the interact button to switch off all alarms there.
Kill the remaining guards. Being seen is fine as long as no alarm rings.

achievements.summary: Activate 9 radio towers.

guide.context: There are 18 towers. Activating all of them uncovers the map and unlocks free gear.

steps.text: Climb a radio tower and remove its scrambler. Repeat for 9 towers.

achievements.summary: Collect 60 relics.

steps.text: Activate all radio towers.
Buy the Items collectible maps in a general store, but not the Treasure maps. Together the maps cost $4000.
Open the map, zoom in and collect relics at the marked spots until you have 60. There are 120 in total.

achievements.summary: Collect all 20 Letters of the Lost.

steps.text: Activate all radio towers and buy the Items collectible maps in a general store.
Collect the letters at the marked spots on the map until you have all 20.

achievements.summary: Collect all 20 memory cards.

guide.context: Some cards sit inside outpost buildings.

steps.text: Activate all radio towers and buy the Items collectible maps in a general store.
Collect the cards at the marked spots on the map until you have all 20.

achievements.description: Unlock 50 entries in the Survival Guide.
achievements.summary: Fill 50 entries of the Survival Guide.

steps.text: Keep playing the story. Entries unlock as you meet people and see places, weapons, vehicles, animals and plants. Check the Handbook tab for progress.

achievements.description: Complete a Path of the Hunter quest.
achievements.summary: Finish one Path of the Hunter hunting quest.

steps.text: Liberate an outpost, then start a Path of the Hunter quest from its map icon.
Hunt and skin the animal with the weapon the quest names.

achievements.summary: Complete a Supply Drop quest.

steps.text: After activating a radio tower, start a Supply Drop quest from its map icon.
Drive the given vehicle through every checkpoint before the time runs out.

achievements.summary: Complete a WANTED Dead quest.

steps.text: Liberate an outpost, then start a Wanted Dead quest from its map icon.
Kill the target with the takedown the quest names.

achievements.description: Beat any Trials of the Rakyat score.
achievements.summary: Beat a score on any Trial of the Rakyat.

steps.text: Find a large red stone with a star icon on the map and interact with it.
Kill as many enemies as you can in the time limit with the weapon you are given. Shoot blue barrels to add time.
Beat the third-place score on the stone. Easy ones are Frag Me Up at X 647.2, Y 763.9 and Transport Destruction at X 756.5, Y 746.0.

achievements.summary: Win $1500 playing poker in total.

guide.context: Winnings add up across games and losses do not subtract. The Father's Burden quest in Thurston Town is an easy place to play.

steps.text: Save, then sit at a poker table on the Expert level and go all in on each hand. A win pays up to $750.
If you lose, reload your save and try again. Check progress under Handbook, World, total poker winnings.

achievements.summary: Kill a predator after it attacks you.

steps.text: Go where crocodiles, sharks, tigers, leopards or Komodo dragons live, such as most rivers for crocodiles.
Let it attack you, then shoot it or stab it while it is on you.

achievements.description: Hunt and skin a rare animal.
achievements.summary: Hunt and skin a rare animal.

guide.context: Path of the Hunter quests open after you liberate outposts.

steps.text: Start a Path of the Hunter quest whose poster has a red Rare stamp. One starts at X 428.9, Y 694.3.
Kill the rare animal and skin it.

achievements.summary: Craft 5 equipment upgrades.

steps.text: Open the Crafting tab in the pause menu. Hunt and skin the animals named under an upgrade such as a holster, wallet or rucksack, then craft it. Do this 5 times.

achievements.summary: Craft 25 syringes.

guide.context: Medicine needs 2 green leaves, Animal Repellent 2 yellow and Enhanced Perception 2 crimson. The Horticulture 101 skill gives 2 leaves per plant.

steps.text: Pick plants to get leaves, then craft syringes in the Crafting tab until you have made 25.

achievements.summary: Craft a special syringe.

steps.text: Find 30 relics to unlock the Untouchable recipe.
The recipe takes five blue leaves, five green leaves and two white leaves. Gather them, then craft the syringe.

achievements.summary: Find the lost Hollywood star.

guide.context: You can do this soon after the game starts.

steps.text: Go to X 619.7, Y 559.4 on a northern island beach and find the man buried up to his head near two bodies hanging from a tree.
Interact with his head.

achievements.description: Kill 50 enemies with the flamethrower (Single Player only).
achievements.summary: Kill 50 enemies with the flamethrower in single player.

guide.context: Kills may not count if you reload before saving.

steps.text: Buy the flamethrower at a shop or unlock it free with radio towers.
Burn enemies at outposts and in missions until 50 die from its fire. Save after each batch.

achievements.description: Kill 4 enemies simultaneously with one explosion (Single Player only).
achievements.summary: Kill 4 enemies with one explosion in single player.

guide.context: C4 on a group of enemies also works. If it fails, die and retry.

steps.text: Get an RPG-7 from a shop or a weapon locker.
At Welshore Wrecker's House outpost, X 437.9, Y 795.0, let the alarm go off but keep one guard alive.
Shoot the second reinforcement Jeep, the one without a turret, with the RPG-7 before its soldiers get out.

achievements.description: Fully distract 25 enemies with rocks (Single Player only).
achievements.summary: Fully distract 25 enemies with thrown rocks in single player.

guide.context: The same enemy can count again. If you have liberated every outpost, enemies remain at X 412.4, Y 729.5.

steps.text: Throw a rock so an enemy walks to the spot, then stay hidden until that enemy goes back to the original post. Do this to 25 enemies.

achievements.description: Kill an enemy with a takedown from above from a glider, zipline or parachute (Single Player only).
achievements.summary: In single player, land on an enemy from a glider, zipline or parachute and kill them with the takedown.

guide.context: The easiest chance is the Medusa's Call story mission. If you are past the story, try a zipline near an outpost or start a new game.

steps.text: Spend a skill point on Death from Above, found in the Heron tree.
Throw a rock to bring guards under a zipline, ride it, and detach above them. The takedown happens on its own.

achievements.description: Kill an enemy with the Repair Tool (Single Player only).
achievements.summary: In single player, kill one enemy using the Repair Tool as a weapon.

steps.text: Pick up the Repair Tool: a weapon locker has it, a general store lists it under Special, and radio towers unlock it free.
Kill all but one guard at an outpost, then burn the last one at close range for 2 to 3 seconds.

achievements.description: Kill a target from 70m or more with the bow (Single Player only).
achievements.summary: Kill a target from 70 m or more with the bow in single player.

guide.context: A good spot near the start is the outpost at Welshore Wrecker's House, X 437.9, Y 795.0.

steps.text: Get the Recurve Bow and buy the Marksman Sight.
Mark an enemy on the map and back away until the distance shows more than 70 m.
Shoot the enemy while it stands still.

achievements.description: Tag 25 enemies using the camera (Single Player only).
achievements.summary: Tag 25 enemies with the camera in single player.

steps.text: Equip the camera and point it at enemies. A tagged enemy shows an orange marker. Tag 25.

achievements.summary: Dive more than 60 m underwater in single player.

steps.text: Take a boat to a dark blue patch of ocean on the map, for example X 709.1, Y 835.6.
Use a Deep Dive syringe and swim down until you reach the seabed.
